ideas.name: signed volume its way over the last 15 minutes
ideas.why: more volume on up bars than down bars (long) is net buying: an order-flow stand-in

ideas.name: higher highs and higher lows over the last hour (long)
ideas.why: trend structure: each pullback bought higher; a breakout in it continues the staircase

ideas.name: a squeeze before the break: the last 10 bars' average range under 0.7 ATR
ideas.why: a coiled market breaks with force; the stops stacked through the squeeze all fill at once

ideas.name: accelerating: the last 5 minutes moved more its way than the 5 before
ideas.why: acceleration into the break is urgency; deceleration is a market running out of buyers

ideas.name: beyond the developing value area its way (above VAH, long)
ideas.why: price leaving the day's value is initiative buying (selling): a trend day's tell

ideas.name: on the trade's side of the developing POC
ideas.why: the day's most-traded price is its fair value; a breakout away from it has the day's acceptance behind it

ideas.name: the last hour's net move its way (any size)
ideas.why: the simplest momentum: the hour's flow already leans the breakout's way

ideas.name: not after a spike: no 1-minute bar over 2.5 ATR in the last 10
ideas.why: a breakout made by one spike is a stop run that reverses; a steady one is buying
